tool_gap.reason: No existing conformance kind can prove outgoing melee miss, parry, and dodge elimination against a judged control arm in which each outcome occurs: (1) CoAGameplayTest.cpp:3522-3524,3550-3555 spawns dummy at x+distance with orientation 0 (facing +X away from caster), REACT_PASSIVE and UNIT_FLAG_DISABLE_MOVE, so Unit.cpp:3411-3415 disables parry (0% parry in both arms), and no existing kind faces a melee target toward the caster or reads facing (nearby_creature_orientation / nearby_creature_facing_offset); (2) CoAGameplayTest.cpp:1793-1803,5316-5356 records only melee_attack_count and melee_damage_count on attacks dealt by the caster (no separate outgoing miss, dodge, or parry counters; meleeVictimStatesTakenFrom/meleeMissesTakenFrom at :1814-1822 record incoming attacks taken by a player only); (3) same_arm_ratio.py:76-99 overwrites verdict.status and drops the control arm completely (a 0%-avoidance control passes), while plain metric_delta cannot judge a non-zero control avoidance count alongside an exact-zero treatment avoidance count sized for <=0.1% residual false-pass probability per pair (at 5% base miss/dodge/parry each, N >= 68 swings/arm/run = 136 per pair gives 0.95^136 = 0.093% <= 0.1%). Nearest kind: metric_delta with attack_swings and same_arm_ratio (needs a target-facing setup + facing read, outgoing per-outcome miss/dodge/parry counters, and a judged non-zero control arm).
